name: AI Retargeting Connector
description: Provisions everything needed in a GHL sub-account to integrate with the AI Retargeting Callback platform. Workflows fire webhooks at our app; custom fields receive call/SMS/email outcomes; tags drive lifecycle.
_notes: GHL Snapshots are exported via their UI. This JSON is the BLUEPRINT — engineering uses it as the source-of-truth when assembling the snapshot inside a master GHL location, or to drive PIT-based programmatic creation where the API permits. Placeholder tokens in URLs (`__APP_BASE_URL__`, `__START_TOKEN__`, `__STOP_TOKEN__`) are patched by the installer after import.

customFields.name: AI Lead Status
customFields.description: queued | calling | answered | engaged | exhausted | stopped

customFields.name: AI Last Outcome
customFields.description: answered | no_answer | voicemail | busy | failed | sms_sent | sms_replied | email_sent | email_clicked | email_bounced

customFields.name: AI Campaign ID
customFields.description: Set by our app on first webhook; lets agency segment by campaign in GHL reports.

customFields.name: SMS Consent
customFields.description: TCPA: required true before SMS step executes.

tags.name: ai-callback
tags.description: Adding this tag enqueues the contact into the configured campaign cadence.

tags.name: stop-ai-callback
tags.description: Adding this tag cancels all queued voice/SMS/email retries for the contact.

tags.name: ai-engaged
tags.description: Set by our app when lead picks up + stays past threshold OR calls back inbound.

tags.name: ai-exhausted
tags.description: Set by our app when max attempts reached without engagement.

workflows.name: AI Retargeting — Start Calling
workflows.description: Fires our start webhook when a contact is tagged 'ai-callback'. Agency may add filters upstream (e.g. source = Facebook).

workflows.name: AI Retargeting — Stop Calling
workflows.description: Cancels all queued retries. Triggered on appointment booked, won opportunity, or 'stop-ai-callback' tag.

installer.fallbackBehavior: If workflow PATCH or workflow CREATE is not exposed by the GHL API for the agency's plan, the installer creates custom fields + tags automatically and presents the workflow JSON in the dashboard for one-paste import via GHL's snapshot-import UI. Webhook URLs are patched post-import if API permits, else copy-paste UI is shown.

placeholderTokens.__APP_BASE_URL__: The Vercel deployment URL for this agency clone, e.g. https://calls.acme-agency.com
placeholderTokens.__START_TOKEN__: Per-campaign opaque secret generated on campaign create — embedded in start webhook URL
placeholderTokens.__STOP_TOKEN__: Per-campaign opaque secret generated on campaign create — embedded in stop webhook URL
placeholderTokens.__CAMPAIGN_ID__: Per-campaign UUID — included in webhook body to aid agency-side segmentation
